FLOW_BUILDER.TITLE: خطة الحصة
FLOW_BUILDER.INTRO: This is your class plan. Build and reorder today's sequence, then start class when ready.
FLOW_BUILDER.NO_MATCHES: No matches. Try a broader search.
FLOW_BUILDER.START_HINT: When your sequence is final, tap Start Class to begin teaching.
FLOW_BUILDER.EMPTY_COPY: Add a first exercise or load a program to start shaping the class structure.

LIBRARY.TITLE: التمارين
LIBRARY.INTRO: Use this page to find single exercises and add them into your class plan one at a time.
LIBRARY.GROUP_HINT: Choose one way to group, then pick a value.
LIBRARY.EMPTY_STATE: No exercises match this setup. Switch browse mode or broaden section/level filters.

TEMPLATES.TITLE: البرامج
TEMPLATES.INTRO: Use this page to load a complete prebuilt program into your class plan in one step.
TEMPLATES.EMPTY_STATE: No programs match the current search. Try broadening the goal, level, or equipment.

TIMER.TITLE: مؤقت الحصة
TIMER.EMPTY_COPY: Go to Class Plan, add exercises, then come back to start class.
TIMER.COMPLETE_COPY: Great work. Reset to run the class again.
TIMER.OUTLINE_HELP: Tap an exercise to jump there while timer is running.

SETTINGS.TITLE: الإعدادات
SETTINGS.DISCLAIMER: FloSmith is a planning tool for instructors. Always adjust flow choices to the class in front of you.
SETTINGS.ACCOUNT_SUBTITLE: Save your instructor email for future sync and export workflows.
SETTINGS.ABOUT_BODY_1: FloSmith helps Pilates instructors shape reusable class structures, keep client context close, and estimate class timing before stepping into the studio.
SETTINGS.ABOUT_BODY_2: Use Programs to preview reusable flows, Exercises to pull single movements, and Home as your day-of-class workspace.
